title: Perfectness is reflected by a nilpotent derived reduction
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subset A$ a nilpotent ideal, so $I^N=0$ for some $N\geq1$. Let $L:D(A)\to D(A/I)$ be derived extension of scalars [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], with its universal left-derived comparison. The two derived localization universes may be chosen independently [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. If $L(C)$ is perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], then $C$ is perfect. No finiteness or boundedness hypothesis on $C$ is required.

source.place: Tag 09C5, first proof paragraph (perfection of the finite quotient models), using more-algebra.tex Tag 09AR (lemma-lift-complex-projectives) and algebra.tex Tag 00DV (lemma-NAK).

proof.text: Choose a bounded finite-projective representative E of L(C). Apply [lem-weil-pbc-nilpotent-projective-complex-lift] to obtain a projective complex P representing C, with an actual termwise reduction isomorphism to E.

If E in degree i is zero, then the quotient of P in degree i by I is zero. Thus that term equals its product with I. Inductively it equals its product with every power of I, so it vanishes. Apply this below and above the bounds of E; P has both bounds.

For any term, its reduction is finite over A/I and hence finite over A. Lift finitely many quotient generators to define a map f from a finite free A-module onto the quotient. The induced map modulo I is surjective, so [lem-weil-pbc-nakayama-nilpotent] makes f itself surjective. Every term of P is therefore finite. Together with projectivity and the bounds, this proves the conclusion.

theorem perfect_of_nilpotent_reduction
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (hI : ∃ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N ∧ I ^ N = ⊥)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⧸ I))]
    (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⧸ I)))
    (ε : Qh ⋙ L ⟶
      @Functor.mapHomotopyCategory _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
        (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).left_adjoint_additive
        (.up ℤ) ⋙ Qh)
    [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ))]
    (C : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hC : IsPerfectRingComplex (L.obj C)) : IsPerfectRingComplex C
